description: Live status, battery, range and state history for your vehicle.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, battery_level AS value FROM (SELECT v.id AS vehicle_id, t.at AS ts, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'batteryLevel') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS battery_level, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'batteryLimit') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS battery_limit, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'distanceToEmpty') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS range_km, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'vehicleMileage') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS mileage_m, (SELECT c.value FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'powerState') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS power_state, (SELECT c.value FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'chargerStatus') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS charger_status, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'cabinClimateInteriorTemperature') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS cabin_temp FROM vehicles v CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT h.at FROM state_heartbeats h WHERE h.vehicle_seq = v.seq UNION SELECT c.at FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.field_id IN (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name IN ('batteryLevel', 'batteryLimit', 'distanceToEmpty', 'vehicleMileage', 'powerState', 'chargerStatus', 'cabinClimateInteriorTemperature'))) t WHERE v.id = ${vehicle:sqlstring}) AS vehicle_state_snapshots WHERE vehicle_id=${vehicle:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
